description: This PHP source file contains database migration scripts that update the schema and data for a specific version upgrade (from v5.0.1 to v5.0.2) in the vtiger CRM project. It executes several SQL queries to modify existing tables, add new tables, and populate data relevant to the new version of the application.

methods.name: ExecuteQuery
methods.description: A function presumed to execute a given SQL query. Its implementation is not included; it's used to run SQL commands within the migration script.
